name: Guilt-Free!

pick.hint: Or click one to choose it.
pick.label: Pick a guilty pleasure
pick.heading: Pick a guilty pleasure and make it green
lead: Everybody has one: the cheap flight to Mallorca, the enormous steak, the 40-minute shower, the new phone every year that you absolutely needed. We know they’re bad for the planet. We do them anyway.
Choose one and reinvent it so that it’s kind to the climate and *still fun*, or everybody will just go back to the old version. Here are some ideas, but you can choose your own.
pick.note: I am not looking for a serious climate strategy here. Some of these will be brilliant and some will be completely unworkable. Both are welcome, as long as you can say who would actually want it.

rows: Which carbon-heavy thing are you rescuing?
The feeling, the convenience, the showing off, the price…
What exactly is it? A product, a service, a place, something completely mad?
Who switches first? The guilty, the smug, someone else?
The one thing it must keep:
What has to stay, or nobody will bother switching?
Who do you get to talk about it, and where?

values.love: It’s the only ten minutes of the day when nobody can email you. In a Berlin winter, it’s also the only time you’re properly warm.
values.version: The Sauna Bus: a solar-powered mobile sauna that parks outside your building twice a week. You get your hot ten minutes, plus twenty more, and your shower at home goes back to a sensible three.
values.who: Students in old Altbau flats whose heating gives up in January, and Finnish exchange students who are shocked we don’t have one already.
values.keep: The silence. There’s a strict no-phones rule, and the driver isn’t allowed to talk about the weather.
values.promote: Parking it outside Berghain on a Sunday morning. The queue does the marketing for you.
